files.README.md:
# order platform workspace

Two services take part in order placement:

- api-gateway terminates client traffic and proxies to the backend services. Plain-text log in logs/api-gateway.log; timestamps are UTC.
- order-service creates orders. JSON-lines log in logs/order-service.log; the ts field is UTC.

Both services stamp the same request id (rq-...) on a call, so a gateway line and the backend record it produced refer to the same request. order-service event codes name the fault that aborted the request.
files.docs/escalation-policy.md:
# Escalation policy

- P1: customer-visible order placement failure; page orders on-call immediately.
- P2: elevated latency without failed requests; notify in #orders-ops within 30 minutes.
- Postmortems are due within two business days and must name the originating fault code.

turns.prompt: This morning a wave of 502s at the edge hit order placement. The postmortem needs the signature of the fault underneath that wave, not the edge symptom. Which error code names it? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
